dev.route_unit.quote: The unit ORBIT-17 is an inspection rover operated by Aster Robotics. Its support contract code is SC-COPPER, not SC-SILVER.

dev.route_owner.quote: ORBIT-17 belongs to the Field Autonomy group. The accountable incident owner for Field Autonomy is the duty coordinator.

dev.route_page.quote: To reach the Field Autonomy duty coordinator, use paging route field-auto-primary. The register intentionally omits personal phone numbers.

dev.route_rule.quote: Contract codes identify service entitlements; asset nicknames and purchase prices do not determine the support response window.

dev.route_diag.quote: Diagnostics for ORBIT-17 must be captured before a motor controller is reset. Capture the controller event log and the battery telemetry bundle.

dev.route_secondary.quote: The rover ORBIT-71 is a different asset assigned to Warehouse Automation. It uses contract SC-SILVER and paging route warehouse-ops.

dev.route_scope.quote: This register covers operational ownership only. Scheduling, replacement parts and commercial discounts require their respective control documents.

dev.contract_copper.quote: SC-COPPER provides a critical-incident acknowledgement target of 25 minutes and a scheduled preventive visit every 6 weeks.

dev.contract_silver.quote: SC-SILVER provides a critical-incident acknowledgement target of 90 minutes and a preventive visit every 12 weeks.

dev.contract_hours.quote: SC-COPPER support operates around the clock. SC-SILVER support operates Monday through Friday from 08:00 to 18:00 UTC, excluding holidays.

dev.contract_restoration.quote: Neither SC-COPPER nor SC-SILVER promises a restoration deadline. An acknowledgement records receipt; it does not mean the rover is repaired.

dev.contract_charge.quote: Contract coverage excludes consumable batteries. Replacement batteries require a separately approved parts order.

dev.contract_expiry.quote: Active contract entitlements override catalog descriptions for the specific asset. Expired contract proposals are not authority for current entitlements.

dev.contract_scope.quote: This matrix specifies support response and visit schedules. It contains no payroll, customer profitability or individual contact records.

dev.part_code.quote: The approved replacement battery for ORBIT-17 is pack BP-42. Pack BP-24 fits ORBIT-71 and must not be fitted to ORBIT-17.

dev.part_price.quote: BP-42 has a list price of EUR 480 per pack. Each pack contains 8 cells and is shipped with a reusable protective case.

dev.part_discount.quote: Orders of at least 10 BP-42 packs receive a 15% discount on the pack price. Freight is EUR 35 per order and is not discounted.

dev.part_stock.quote: The catalog stock ledger lists 36 BP-42 packs available on 4 February 2026. This is a dated stock count, not a promise of future availability.

dev.part_safety.quote: Battery packs may be installed only after the rover has been isolated from charging equipment. The protective case is not an electrical isolation device.

dev.part_warranty.quote: Unopened BP-42 packs have a 12-month warranty from dispatch. Installing a pack does not extend the original dispatch-based warranty.

dev.part_scope.quote: Prices exclude tax. No applicable tax rate is specified, so a tax-inclusive total cannot be derived from this catalog.

dev.ship_class.quote: BP-42 battery packs use transport class DG-9. DG-9 shipments require a signed dangerous-goods declaration.

dev.ship_route.quote: DG-9 shipments leave the East depot on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Ordinary replacement wheels may leave on any working day.

dev.ship_lead.quote: After approval, domestic DG-9 orders require 3 working days for preparation before the next eligible dispatch day.

dev.ship_label.quote: Each DG-9 shipping case must show the pack model, dispatch date and handling orientation. Customer account passwords must never appear on the label.

dev.ship_contact.quote: The dispatch queue owner is Logistics Control. Finance approval and signed transport paperwork are independent gates before release.

dev.ship_proof.quote: Proof of dispatch is the carrier acceptance scan. Printing a label alone does not establish that a pack has left the depot.

dev.ship_scope.quote: International customs duties and country-specific transport exceptions are outside this domestic instruction.

dev.old_status.quote: The 2024 workshop safety edition expired on 31 December 2025. It is retained for historical audits and does not govern work in 2026.

dev.old_check.quote: Under the 2024 edition, a rover returning from outdoor service required an insulation check every 120 operating hours.

dev.old_sign.quote: The 2024 edition allowed the shift supervisor alone to authorize a return to service.

dev.old_temp.quote: The 2024 charging-room temperature ceiling was 32 degrees Celsius.

dev.old_archive.quote: Historical inspection sheets record the edition used at the time. Do not silently replace a historical threshold with a newer threshold in audit records.

dev.old_examples.quote: An audit of a November 2025 repair must use the rules effective in November 2025, even if the audit itself happens the following year.

dev.new_check.quote: From 1 January 2026, a rover returning from outdoor service requires an insulation check every 80 operating hours.

dev.new_sign.quote: Return to service requires two approvals: the shift supervisor and a certified electrical inspector. Neither approval alone is sufficient.

dev.new_temp.quote: Charging must pause when the room temperature exceeds 28 degrees Celsius. Work may resume only after the room has cooled to 26 degrees Celsius or below.

dev.new_fail.quote: A failed insulation check requires quarantine in Bay Q2 and a new inspection after repair. Resetting the inspection timer does not clear a failed result.

dev.new_scope.quote: These rules govern all Aster workshop shifts from their effective date. They replace the 2024 edition, including its single-approver exception.

dev.new_records.quote: The inspection ledger must record the asset ID, operating-hour counter, result and both approvers. Photographs supplement but do not replace those fields.

dev.fin_revenue.quote: Fiscal 2025 revenue was EUR 3.6 million, compared with EUR 3.0 million in fiscal 2024. These are recognized revenues, not order bookings.

dev.fin_profit.quote: Fiscal 2025 operating costs were EUR 2.7 million and operating profit was EUR 0.9 million. Finance charges are excluded from operating profit.

dev.fin_segments.quote: Service contracts produced EUR 2.16 million of fiscal 2025 revenue. Hardware sales produced the remaining EUR 1.44 million.

dev.fin_orders.quote: The fiscal 2025 year-end order backlog was EUR 1.1 million. Backlog is not included in recognized revenue until delivery criteria are met.

dev.fin_currency.quote: All monetary figures in these accounts are in euros. No foreign exchange rates or geographic revenue breakdowns are included.

dev.fin_audit.quote: These fictional management accounts are unaudited. Figures are provided as a calculation exercise and should not be interpreted as an investment recommendation.

dev.ret_telemetry.quote: Routine rover telemetry is retained for 45 days after collection. Incident-linked telemetry is retained for 18 months after incident closure.

dev.ret_invoices.quote: Supplier invoices are retained for 7 years after the end of the relevant fiscal year. Unapproved draft purchase requests are retained for 60 days.

dev.ret_access.quote: Temporary export links expire after 48 hours. Expiry of a link does not delete the retained underlying record.

dev.ret_owner.quote: Records Operations owns the retention schedule. A legal hold suspends deletion until Legal explicitly releases the hold.

dev.ret_priority.quote: Where an incident tag and a routine telemetry tag both apply, the incident-linked retention period takes precedence.

dev.ret_scope.quote: The schedule does not contain biometric retention rules, encryption secrets or employee benefit records. Those subjects must not be inferred from telemetry durations.

dev.ops_flag.quote: Feature switch ROVER_SAFE_PATH defaults to enabled in production. Its documented values are enabled and disabled, not numeric levels.

dev.ops_probe.quote: The rover gateway readiness probe is GET /ready/rover. GET /health/rover reports process liveness and must not be substituted for readiness.

dev.ops_canary.quote: A release begins with 4 rovers in the canary cohort and an observation window of 35 minutes.

dev.ops_abort.quote: Stop rollout when command rejection exceeds 1.5% for 4 consecutive minutes. A single transient sample does not satisfy this stopping condition.

dev.ops_rollback.quote: Rollback restores the preceding firmware image. It does not undo calibration changes stored on the motor controller.

dev.ops_review.quote: After rollback, retain the failed-image identifier and observation logs. The release engineer records the result before scheduling a new canary.

dev.train_pack.quote: BP-42 handling requires certification BAT-L2. General mechanical induction alone does not authorize battery-pack handling.

dev.train_valid.quote: BAT-L2 certification remains valid for 9 months from assessment. A failed reassessment immediately suspends pack-handling access.

dev.train_exam.quote: The BAT-L2 assessment contains 24 questions; a candidate must answer at least 21 correctly to pass.

dev.train_booking.quote: Assessment bookings close 5 working days before the session. Supervisors may request a later session but cannot waive the assessment.

dev.train_register.quote: The competence register records certificate code and expiry date, not personal exam answers. Access checks must use the certificate expiry, not the booking date.

dev.train_scope.quote: The training schedule is separate from product warranty and support entitlements. A long support contract does not extend a technician certificate.

dev.distract_proposal.quote: This rejected draft proposed SC-COPPER acknowledgement in 10 minutes and BP-42 packs at EUR 400. Neither proposal was approved or made effective.

dev.distract_proposal2.quote: The draft requested a 25% bulk-order discount. Procurement declined that request and instructed staff to use the approved parts catalog.

dev.distract_proposal3.quote: This document is a deliberately obsolete distractor. An exact product-name match does not make its commercial terms authoritative.

dev.distract_warehouse.quote: Warehouse trolley ORBIT-170 is not rover ORBIT-17. The trolley uses cell cartridge BP-420 and does not accept rover pack BP-42.

dev.distract_warehouse2.quote: BP-420 cartridges are priced at EUR 75 and have no relationship to the BP-42 rover-pack price or discount.

dev.distract_warehouse3.quote: Warehouse staff retain trolley route logs for 10 days. That period is not a retention rule for rover telemetry.

held_out.map_instrument.quote: The instrument LUMEN-8 is assigned to programme NIGHTGLASS. Its detector assembly is model CCD-K7.

held_out.map_programme.quote: Programme NIGHTGLASS is funded by grant GR-204. The programme lead is the observing coordinator, not the facilities manager.

held_out.map_room.quote: LUMEN-8 is installed in dome D3. The visually similar guide camera LUMEN-80 is installed in dome D1 and is not part of NIGHTGLASS.

held_out.map_schedule.quote: NIGHTGLASS observing blocks start at 22:30 UTC. Clock times in this register use UTC throughout the year without daylight-saving adjustments.

held_out.map_scope.quote: This register links instruments, programmes and locations. It does not specify grant purchase limits or detector procurement procedures.

held_out.map_tracking.quote: Staff must record the exact instrument suffix in fault reports. Dropping the zero from LUMEN-80 can send a guide-camera issue to the wrong instrument team.

held_out.grant_limit.quote: Grant GR-204 requires two written quotations for any single equipment purchase above GBP 2500. Splitting one purchase into invoices does not remove this requirement.

held_out.grant_quota.quote: GR-204 allocates 160 observing hours per quarter. Unused hours expire at quarter end and cannot be carried forward.

held_out.grant_window.quote: GR-204 eligible expenditure must be incurred between 1 April 2026 and 31 March 2027. Purchase authorization alone is not evidence that expenditure was incurred.

held_out.grant_sign.quote: The research finance officer must approve GR-204 equipment purchases. Approval by the observing coordinator alone is insufficient.

held_out.grant_scope.quote: Grant GR-811 belongs to the solar-monitoring programme and has different conditions. GR-204 limits must not be copied into a GR-811 approval record.

held_out.grant_mirror.quote: For GR-204, the current instrument allocation is 160 observing hours in each quarter; unused allocation expires at that quarter end.

held_out.detector_vendor.quote: The sole approved supplier of CCD-K7 detector assemblies is Meridian Optics. The approved procurement route is a sealed purchase order to that supplier.

held_out.detector_price.quote: One CCD-K7 assembly costs GBP 3200 before tax and freight. The procurement sheet does not state a tax rate or a freight charge.

held_out.detector_lead.quote: CCD-K7 quoted manufacturing lead time is 7 weeks from supplier order acceptance. Delivery transit time is additional and is not specified.

held_out.detector_maintenance.quote: A CCD-K7 assembly requires a calibration exposure sequence every 30 nights of use. Calendar months are not a substitute for counting nights of use.

held_out.detector_warranty.quote: The CCD-K7 warranty is 18 months from acceptance testing. Accidental damage is excluded; routine calibration remains the observatory responsibility.

held_out.detector_alternate.quote: CCD-K70 assemblies are an incompatible product and are not approved replacements for CCD-K7. Similar naming is not a substitution authorization.

held_out.vendor_deposit.quote: Meridian Optics requires a 30% deposit when accepting a CCD-K7 order. The balance is payable after acceptance testing.

held_out.vendor_dispatch.quote: Meridian Optics dispatches detector assemblies from its North quay laboratory. The South quay site handles mirrors only.

held_out.vendor_payment.quote: Supplier bank details are withheld from this public testing corpus. Staff must obtain verified details through the finance system.

held_out.vendor_reference.quote: Purchase orders must include the instrument model and grant code. A delivery address alone is not enough to identify the funding authorization.

held_out.vendor_scope.quote: A supplier deposit is part of the assembly price, not a surcharge. The register does not override grant quotation thresholds or approval roles.

held_out.vendor_change.quote: A request to change supplier payment details must be independently verified by the research finance officer before any payment is released.

held_out.access_old.quote: The 2023 visitor rules permitted unescorted dome access after a 20-minute induction. This edition ceased to apply on 30 June 2026.

held_out.access_old_hours.quote: Under the 2023 rules, visitor badges remained valid for 72 hours from issue. Audit records for historical visits must retain the original issue time.

held_out.access_old_weather.quote: The 2023 edition closed external observing platforms at sustained wind speeds above 45 km/h.

held_out.access_old_authority.quote: This retired edition is stored for incident reconstruction. It must not be used to authorize a new visit after its expiry date.

held_out.access_old_book.quote: The historical visitor book records the host and visit date. It contains no current emergency permissions.

held_out.access_new.quote: From 1 July 2026, all visitors in domes must be accompanied by an accredited host. Completing an induction does not waive the escort requirement.

held_out.access_new_hours.quote: Visitor badges issued under the July 2026 rules expire 12 hours after issue. A host cannot extend a badge by writing a new expiry on it.

held_out.access_new_weather.quote: External observing platforms close when sustained wind exceeds 35 km/h. A weather closure takes precedence over a previously approved visitor booking.

held_out.access_new_after.quote: After a weather closure, the facilities controller must authorize reopening. A visitor host is not authorized to reopen the platform.

held_out.access_new_scope.quote: These rules supersede the 2023 edition for visits from 1 July 2026. They do not change the historical record of visits completed before that date.

held_out.access_new_record.quote: Hosts record visitor entry and exit in the live register. Badge issue time and visitor arrival time are separate fields and must not be conflated.

held_out.arc_raw.quote: Raw spectrograph frames are retained for 120 days after acquisition. Calibrated science products are retained for 6 years after publication.

held_out.arc_embargo.quote: NIGHTGLASS calibrated products carry an embargo of 9 months after acquisition. Embargo expiry controls public access, not the retention clock.

held_out.arc_code.quote: Archive collection identifier NG-CAL-6Y selects calibrated NIGHTGLASS products. NG-RAW-120D selects the raw-frame collection.

held_out.arc_checksum.quote: The archive verifies SHA-256 checksums when accepting an upload. A matching checksum detects byte changes but does not prove scientific correctness.

held_out.arc_process.quote: To retrieve an embargoed product, first authenticate the researcher, then verify programme membership, then issue a time-limited download link.

held_out.arc_membership.quote: Embargoed NIGHTGLASS products may be accessed by members of programme NIGHTGLASS. Funding-agency staff do not automatically inherit programme membership.

held_out.arc_scope.quote: The archive specification describes retention and access only. It contains no scientific discovery dates or undisclosed observational results.

held_out.maint_fault.quote: Fault FLT-208 concerns the coolant pump for LUMEN-8. It requires a coolant isolation check before any pump restart.

held_out.maint_fluid.quote: The LUMEN-8 coolant loop holds 24 litres when full. After draining 6 litres, refill the loop to its full level before the isolation test.

held_out.maint_lock.quote: A failed coolant isolation check requires lockout under tag COOL-LOCK. Only a certified cooling technician may release COOL-LOCK after a passing retest.

held_out.maint_interval.quote: Dome D3 shutter seals are inspected every 45 days. The detector calibration interval is controlled by the detector procurement sheet, not by this shutter schedule.

held_out.maint_queue.quote: Routine maintenance requests enter queue OBS-MAINT. A coolant leak during observing is escalated immediately to the duty facilities controller.

held_out.maint_scope.quote: The maintenance log does not list pump serial numbers or spare-part shelf counts. Technicians must consult the asset store for those details.

held_out.cap_hours.quote: During quarter Q2, usable observing capacity was 240 hours and executed observations used 180 hours. Weather losses are already excluded from usable capacity.

held_out.cap_spend.quote: The Q2 instrument budget was GBP 48000 and recorded instrument expenditure was GBP 36000. Unspent budget is not an authorization to bypass grant controls.

held_out.cap_energy.quote: Dome D3 consumed 1500 kWh in April and 1800 kWh in May. These figures cover the dome supply, not only the LUMEN-8 detector.

held_out.cap_nights.quote: Q2 included 30 scheduled observing nights and 6 were cancelled. A partially completed night still counts as a scheduled night in this statement.

held_out.cap_scope.quote: This fictional statement excludes electricity unit prices, staffing costs and visitor revenue. Those quantities cannot be recovered from energy or hour totals.

held_out.cap_method.quote: Executed hours count time actually spent observing. Requested hours and scheduled hours are separate planning measures and are not reported here.

held_out.net_port.quote: The telescope telemetry collector listens on TCP port 7443. Port 7444 is reserved for a maintenance console, not the collector.

held_out.net_token.quote: Setting OBS_LINK_TTL_SECONDS has value 900. It controls archive download-link lifetime in seconds and does not set scientific data retention.

held_out.net_retry.quote: Telemetry clients wait 12 seconds before the first retry, then 24 seconds before the second retry. No additional retries are permitted by this profile.

held_out.net_probe.quote: The telemetry readiness endpoint is /observe/ready. A successful TCP connection alone is not a readiness assertion.

held_out.net_window.quote: The collector accepts a maximum of 80 frames in one upload batch. Larger uploads must be divided without changing individual frame checksums.

held_out.net_scope.quote: This configuration note includes public setting names only. Authentication tokens, host certificates and signing keys are deliberately absent.

held_out.held_draft.quote: This unapproved bid requested 300 quarterly hours for NIGHTGLASS and detector assemblies at GBP 2800. Neither value is an approved grant or procurement term.

held_out.held_draft2.quote: The bid proposed waiving written quotations and allowing unescorted visitors after dark. These proposals did not become operational rules.

held_out.held_draft3.quote: The bid is retained as a search distractor; approved registers and dated effective rules take precedence.

held_out.held_guide.quote: LUMEN-80 is a guide camera in dome D1. Its detector model is CMOS-J2, not CCD-K7, and its programme is DAYFINDER.

held_out.held_guide2.quote: DAYFINDER uses grant GR-811. Its allocated hours are not the NIGHTGLASS allocation, and this sheet does not disclose GR-811 purchase limits.

held_out.held_guide3.quote: The guide-camera store retains preview thumbnails for 14 days. Thumbnails are not the raw spectrograph frames governed by the scientific archive.

questions.question: What acknowledgement target and visit interval apply to rover ORBIT-71?

questions.question: For ORBIT-17, does around-the-clock support imply a guaranteed repair deadline?

questions.question: Which production asset battery requires a 9-month handling certificate, and what is that certificate called?
questions.expected_answer: ORBIT-17 uses BP-42; BP-42 handling needs BAT-L2, valid for 9 months.

questions.question: Why must the price for an ORBIT-17 replacement pack come from the approved catalog rather than the rejected proposal?
questions.expected_answer: The approved pack is BP-42 at EUR 480; the rejected EUR 400 offer never took effect.

questions.question: What dispatch classification and preparation lead time apply to the approved replacement pack for ORBIT-17?

questions.question: Compare the acknowledgement targets of SC-COPPER and SC-SILVER.

questions.question: How does retention differ for routine and incident-linked rover telemetry?

questions.question: How do BP-42 rover packs differ from similarly named warehouse BP-420 cartridges in model suitability and price?

questions.question: Compare the effective and rejected proposed bulk-discount percentages for BP-42.
questions.expected_answer: The approved discount is 15%; the proposed 25% discount was declined.

questions.question: What is the battery price?
